text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 24, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last
issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 11.920 million UAH 66.793 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.431 million UAH 58.451 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 119,200 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for Thursday, September 26.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.87 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 24, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 292,300 UAH 7.203 million UAH
The central bank sold 3,796 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for Thursday, September 26.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills stood at 61.96 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 24, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold one T-bill, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled on September 26.
